info.title: Motifuse Developer API
info.summary: One server-to-server API for DocForge, Reconova, and Spectrace.
info.description: The stable Motifuse /v1 contract. API keys are secrets and must never be embedded in browser JavaScript, mobile bundles, or public repositories. Long-running operations are asynchronous and return jobs or resources linked to jobs.

tags.name: DocForge
tags.description: Deterministic document generation from published templates.

tags.name: Reconova
tags.description: Direct-upload data profiling and cleaning workflows.

tags.name: Spectrace
tags.description: Deterministic document change comparison and review.

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Ownership-checked direct uploads and short-lived downloads.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Signed, retried event delivery with SSRF-protected destinations.

bearerAuth.description: Server-side Motifuse API key. Never expose it in client-side code.

RequestId.name: X-Request-Id
RequestId.description: Optional caller correlation ID. Motifuse returns a request ID on every response.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required for safe retries of expensive mutations. Retained for 24 hours. Reuse with a different payload returns 409.

RequestId.description: Correlation ID for support and logs.
